main_body: A tall narrow strip (about 16px wide, 48 rows tall): a vertical wooden post/plank column on the left, a dark band, and on the right three repeated small wooden blocks, each with a light top square and a brown front, stacked vertically with gaps. It reads as a fence/plank strip drawn straight from the front.
top_band: none: column x=3 is one uniform brown run (rows 0-47, L=98) with no lighter top band; x=8 has a 1-row highlight (row 3, L=173) inside a block, not a top surface
evidence: The left post is a uniform vertical brown strip with no top surface. The right-hand blocks are repeated small panels with a 1-2 row light patch at the top and a vertical face below, so they are rim-only/front-elevation. The dark column at x=5 is a flat dark fill with gaps. There is no open frame with beams or a base showing top faces, so it fails the frame contract. The drawing also does not look like a farm frame, so kind_matches is false.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The wood has roughly 4 shading steps (highlight, light, mid, dark) against 5-6 in the references. Dark edge pixels are tinted rather than neutral (0% neutral), so the outline is a dark brown, not black. There are no 5x5 flat fills, but the texture is sparse: a vertical stripe and repeated blocks with little grain. It is much thinner than the references.
